capabilities: Compile LaTeX code blocks to PDF or SVG
Reference vault files and named code blocks as LaTeX dependencies
Download and cache TeX Live packages on demand
Show compilation errors and a structured full log with warnings and dependencies
Save, recompile and export rendered output from a per-render menu
disambiguation: Not a math or TikZ equation renderer; it compiles complete multi-page LaTeX documents to PDF or SVG.
extras: Compilation is disabled on iOS (cached renders only). Downloads TeX packages from a third-party mirror at texlive.texlyre.org; internet is needed only for uncached packages. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Supports existing tikz code blocks for compatibility.
intentEvidence: This plugin is based on obsidian-latex-render by fenjalien.
problem: Rendering full LaTeX documents normally requires installing and configuring a system TeX distribution, which is impractical in Obsidian and especially on mobile.

relations.evidence: This plugin is based on obsidian-latex-render by fenjalien.
to SwiftLaTeX for making it possible to run LaTeX engines in the browser (this plugin uses a modified fork)
to Texlyre for maintaining the TeX Live mirror used to download packages on demand.

summary: Full LaTeX compiler inside code blocks that renders complete documents to PDF or SVG using bundled TeX engines and on-demand TeX Live packages.
